items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: I worked for that year and a half with the Jazz Monitor as Chuck and Chuckles. That's Harold Kroma --you know. We worked quite a ways there.

ctx.x: It was Gloria Kroma's husband, Harold Kroma.

items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: He was known as the Monitor, you know, the Jazz Monitor, see, at that time.

ctx.x: Yes, yes. He was known as the Monitor, you know, the Jazz Monitor, see, at that time. Sammy Davis, Jr., -- he was inspired by Harold Kroma, the Jazz Monitor. As you know, Sammy Davis, Jr., reached all heights, you know.
